data.content: # Mets predicted to win bidding war for $32M two-time Cy Young winner to stabilize rotation. It is no secret that the New York Mets were baseball's most disappointing team in 2026, with injuries and poor play contributing to their struggles. This offseason will be a significant one for the organization as it looks to put together the right roster for a turnaround. Whether it is the bullpen or the starting rotation, New York is going to need to add pitching this offseason. Upgrading the starting rotation remains a top priority, but the Mets also need to revamp their bullpen after trading away four relievers at the deadline,” SI’s Tommy Kelson wrote. One thing that is clear in New York is that Nolan McLean has all the talent necessary to become the team's ace in 2027 and beyond. Landing the biggest fish of all on the market would provide all that and meet a clear need,” Perry wrote.

data.content: # Mets predicted to sign ex-Dodgers 2-time Cy Young award winner to form filthy duo with Nolan McLean. The New York Mets are coming off a disappointing 2026 season in which they fell short of their goal of making the playoffs. Starting pitching will be one of New York's biggest priorities. They also have one of the game's best young arms in Nolan McLean, who could become a cornerstone of their rotation for years to come. To make the playoffs in 2027, they will need more of it. Having a multiple-time Cy Young Award winner and All-Star like Skubal at the top of the rotation would give the Mets another reliable arm to lean on when those difficult stretches arrive. Pairing Skubal with McLean would give New York a formidable one-two punch at the top of its rotation, while allowing the team to explore moves for another quality starter to round out the group.

data.title: Braves predicted to sign $6.2M starter who had career resurgence with Orioles to be Chris Sale heir - www.sportingnews.c
data.content: # Braves predicted to sign $6.2M starter who had career resurgence with Orioles to be Chris Sale heir. The Atlanta Braves are entering an offseason in which starting pitching will be a major priority, with so much uncertainty surrounding the rotation for 2027. “While it wasn't their downfall in the end, the starting rotation has been a constant thorn in the Atlanta Braves' side for multiple seasons now. As the page turns to 2027, it's to see how it shakes up. But all three dealt with injuries and can't be counted on to pitch in 2027," The Athletic's Jesus Cano wrote. With so much uncertainty surrounding the rotation, the Braves are expected to be aggressive in addressing their pitching needs. “The Braves were hit with a litany of pitching injuries last season and still won the division, but there are a ton of question marks here. He could eventually become Chris Sale’s successor as the top left-handed option in Atlanta's rotation.
